questions.hint: tan A=21/20→BC=21k, AC=20k, AB=29k；∠D↔∠A，sin D=sin A=21/29（2.9为缩放，不影响正弦）
questions.stem: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF, where angle A corresponds to angle D and angles C and F are right angles. The length of AB is 2.9 times the length of DE. If tan A = 21/20, what is the value of sin D?

ledger.recompute: ∠C、∠F直角，tan A=BC/AC=21/20→BC=21k, AC=20k, AB=√(21²+20²)k=29k；∠D↔∠A，sin D=sin A=BC/AB=21/29（独立复算）

questions.stem: In triangle XYZ, angle Y is a right angle, the measure of angle Z is 39°, and the length of YZ is 28 units. If the area, in square units, of triangle XYZ can be represented by the expression k tan 39°, where k is a constant, what is the value of k?

ledger.recompute: 直角在Y，tan Z=XY/YZ → XY=28tan39°；面积=½·YZ·XY=½·28·28tan39°=392tan39° → k=392（独立复算）

ledger.recompute: 单位圆上 x=−1 → y=0，H=(−1,0)；GF在正x轴，GH在负x轴，∠FGH≡π (mod 2π)；57π=28·2π+π 符合；59π/2、61π/2 为半圈倍数（终边y轴），56π=28·2π（终边正x轴）均不符 → D（独立复算）
